excerpts: h1#npi-files NPI Files. Effective 03/03/2026 NPPES will no longer support Version 1 of the Monthly and Weekly Downloadable File; V2 has extended First Name / Legal Business Name lengths. Each zipped file includes 3 reference files: Other Name (Type 2 additional names), Practice Location (non-primary locations, Type 1+2), Endpoint (Type 1+2).
